notes: Karyotype 60 XY; Tissue type: Tissue, Smooth muscle, Artery, Aorta, thoracic; Age: 3; Age Unit: MO; Remarks: The tissue of origin for this culture is the medial layer of the upper thoracic aorta. The culture was initiated 9/80. The cell morphology is fibroblast-like. The culture tested positive for alpha-smooth muscle actin (immunofluorescence assay). The karyotype is 60,XY; normal diploid male. The cells have a strong histamine signal (receptor) and deposit collagen post-confluence with addition of ascorbate.

Tissue type: Tissue, Mesothelial, Lung, Lung; Remarks: Holstein breed. The culture was initiated from the lung of a fetal calf on 12/27/79. The pleura was mechanically stripped from the lung, digested with trypsin, and released cells were plated. The cell morphology is epithelial-like. The karyotype is 60,XX; normal diploid female.

Tissue type: Tissue, Endothelial, Artery, Aorta, thoracic; Age: 18; Age Unit: FW; Remarks: Holstein breed. The thoracic aorta was obtained on 4/25/79 from a 4 to 5 month old fetus. The culture was initiated using cells released from the lumen of the vessel by collagenase digestion. Plasma-derived serum was used in the primary culture to select against possible smooth muscle cell contaminants. The cell morphology is polygonal. The karyotype is 60,XY; normal diploid male. This culture tested positive for the endothelial cellspecific von Willebrand factor and negative for alpha-smooth muscle actin (immunofluorescence assays) and positive for angiotensin-1 converting enzyme activity. Culture tested negative for bovine viruses BVD, PI-3 and BHV-1 prior to submission to the Repository. Same culture, line BFAE-39, at later passage is AG04762A.

Tissue type: Tissue, Endothelial, Artery, Aorta, thoracic; Age: 20; Age Unit: FW; Remarks: Holstein breed. The thoracic aorta was obtained on 5/17/79 from a 5 month old fetus. The culture was initiated using cells released from the lumen of the vessel by collagenase digestion. Plasma-derived serum was used in the primary culture to select against possible smooth muscle cell contaminants. The cell morphology is polygonal. Karyotype is 60,XX; normal diploid female. The culture tested positive for von Willebrand factor and negative for bovine viruses BVD, PI-3 and BHV-1. Culture, line BFAE-45, medium: HF12 15I.

Tissue type: Tissue, Fibroblast, Skin, Thigh; Age: 2; Age Unit: YR; Remarks: Holstein breed. The skin biopsy was taken 4 hours post-mortem on 4/18/85 from the inner thigh. Culture was initiated using explants of minced skin tissue. Cell morphology is fibroblast-like. The karyotype is 60,XX; normal diploid female. Other cultures from this cow cow are AG08131A, AG08132B, and AG08133A.

Tissue type: Tissue, Fibroblast, Skin, Thigh; Age: 2; Age Unit: DA; Remarks: Angus breed. The skin biopsy was taken post-mortem on 9/18/85 from the inner thigh. The culture was initiated using explants of minced skin tissue. Cell morphology is fibroblast-like. The karyotype is 60,XX; normal diploid female.

Tissue type: Tissue, Endothelial, Artery, Aorta, thoracic; Age: 1; Age Unit: YR; Remarks: Hereford breed. The age of the donor is estimated. The thoracic aorta was removed immediately post-mortem on 10/22/85. The culture was initiated from cells released from the lumen of the vessel by collagenase digestion. The cell morphology is polygonal. The culture tested positive for endothelial cell-specific von Willebrand factor and negative for alpha-smooth muscle actin (immunofluorescence assays). The karyotype is 60,XY; normal diploid male. The first and second passage cells were propagated in medium supplemented with horse plasma-derived serum and heparin (0.1mg/ml) on gelatin-coated flasks. The culture was grown on gelatin-coated flasks and the medium was supplemented with  ECGS (0.02 mg/ml) and heparin (0.05 mg/ml). Culture medium: AMMC 15U with supplements. For lifespan determination this cell line was cultured in Ham's F12 medium with 10% inactivated fetal bovine serum.

The cell morphology is fibroblast-like. The culture tested positive for alpha-smooth muscle actin and negative for the endothelial cell-specific von Willebrand factor (immunofluorescence assays).
